text: On 12 October 2006, Mr M., a leader of a human rights association called 'Mashr' based in Nazran, the Republic of Ingushetia, submitted a notification of a planned stationary demonstration (picket) to the authorities.

text: The planned picket was to be held on 16 October 2006 from 4 p.m. to 6 p.m. near the monument to the heroes of the Second World War on Bazorkina Avenue in Nazran, the Republic of Ingushetia.
section_path: THE FACTS

text: The purpose of the planned picket was to commemorate the journalist Anna Politkovskaya, who was murdered on 7 October 2006.

text: On 15 October 2006, the director of the human rights association Mashr received a handwritten letter from the Head of Nazran City Administration banning the planned picket.
section_path: THE FACTS

text: The Head of Nazran City Administration banned the planned picket on the grounds that Mashr, being a non-commercial organisation, had no right to organise it.

text: Considering the decision of the Nazran City Administration to be in breach of the law, Mr M. went ahead with the organisation of the picket.

text: Mr M. intended to challenge the decision of the Nazran City Administration banning the picket at a later stage.
